title: AutoSec-RAN: Specification-Grounded LLM Fine-Tuning for Automated Security Analysis of O-RAN
abstract: arXiv:2610.15995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents AutoSec-RAN, a specification-grounded large language model (LLM) framework for automated security triage of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) testing. Unlike approaches relying on static rule sets or privileged access to raw packet captures, AutoSec-RAN fine-tunes Mistral-7B-Instruct through two Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) stages over a curated corpus of 69 O-RAN, 3GPP, and adjacent standards documents, then selectively augments inference with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the same specification index. At inference, the model receives only an investigator-style question and a scenario metadata block, simulating an automated analyst operating without raw packet evidence. AutoSec-RAN is validated on a purpose-built 5G/O-RAN testbed across labeled fronthaul distributed denial of service replay scenarios. translated_title: AutoSec-RAN：基于规范的大语言模型微调，用于 O-RAN 的自动化安全分析
translated_abstract: 本文提出了 AutoSec-RAN，这是一个基于规范、面向开放式无线接入网（O-RAN）测试自动化安全分诊的大语言模型（LLM）框架。与依赖静态规则集或需要对原始数据包捕获具有特权访问权限的方法不同，AutoSec-RAN 在包含 69 份 O-RAN、3GPP 及相关标准文档的精选语料库上，通过两个低秩适配（LoRA）阶段对 Mistral-7B-Instruct 进行微调，随后在推理阶段选择性地结合针对同一规范索引的检索增强生成（RAG）。在推理时，模型仅接收一个调查员风格的问题和一个场景元数据块，从而模拟一个在缺乏原始数据包证据情况下工作的自动化分析师。AutoSec-RAN 在专门构建的 5G/O-RAN 测试床上，通过带标签的前传分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）重放场景进行了验证。由 Gemma-4-31B 评判 LLM 从忠实性、正确性和可操作性等维度对每个候选答案进行评分……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: AutoSec-RAN 通过在 69 份 O-RAN/3GPP 规范文档上进行两阶段 LoRA 微调并结合选择性 RAG，实现了无需原始数据包证据即可对 O-RAN 测试进行自动化安全分诊的规范驱动型大语言模型框架。
en_tdlr: AutoSec-RAN is a specification-grounded LLM framework that fine-tunes Mistral-7B-Instruct through two-stage LoRA over 69 O-RAN/3GPP standards documents with selective RAG, enabling automated security triage of O-RAN testing without access to raw packet captures.
